exposure: Women who had nausea during the observed period
cohort: 25 pregnant women scheduled for elective cesarean section under spinal anesthesia
finding: The changes in cerebral hemodynamics may be small after spinal anesthesia in ordinary cesarean section compared to the reduction of systemic arterial blood pressure.
mod_finding: The study investigated changes in cerebral oxygenation and blood flow after spinal anesthesia for cesarean section.
